receiver_a:
Create a polished fighting-game animation direction review sheet, not a runtime atlas. Use the attached images as the strict identity and costume reference for Fillet: short spiky BLACK hair, slender athletic adult woman, red armor on her anatomical LEFT shoulder, ivory open-neck shirt, fitted brown corset and pouches, brown loose trousers, substantial strapped boots, long knife in anatomical RIGHT hand and short knife in LEFT. Consistent mature cel-shaded anatomy, 7.5-head standing-equivalent proportions, thin arms, identical head/hand/boot sizes in EVERY drawing. Preserve the current angular red/ivory/brown silhouette. No growth when reacting, no chibi, no stretchy limbs, no smearing, no blood, no impact VFX, no opponent.
PORTRAIT review sheet, large readable drawings, exactly FOUR ROWS by THREE COLUMNS = TWELVE full-body drawings. Each row is one hit-reaction timeline with clear cream labels: row 1 LEG HIT; row 2 CHEST HIT; row 3 HEAD HIT; row 4 AIR HIT. Column labels: CONTACT / RECOIL / STUN HOLD. Three poses must visibly tell one action, not three unrelated stances. Thin gold curved ARROWS between poses show torso/limb motion direction. Same camera, same relative anatomical scale and consistent ground line across grounded rows; airborne row uses a dotted root-height guide and never implies a new gameplay launch. Dark desaturated blue-gray background. No panels cropped, no giant decorative text. Most generous canvas detail available.
Reactions must be clearly distinct: LEG knee and hip compression with lower focus, CHEST ribcage fold with elbows drawing inward, HEAD chin/head snap with upper-back response, AIR whole-body suspended recoil with knees and free arm trailing. Knives stay held passively, never look like an attack. A contact drawing will hold during hitstop; the third pose is still visibly stunned, not fully recovered or ready to attack.
Title: A / COMPACT SNAP. Distinct weighty, disciplined reactions: a hard local joint snap on contact, then contained whole-body follow-through. Grounded boots keep a credible support foot; chest and head recoil never lean dramatically off balance. Air reaction uses a compact C-shaped curl and hanging legs. Emphasize strong clean readable silhouettes with modest body travel and purposeful asymmetry.
